title: Privacy Policy and Terms of Service

titleLocales.en: Privacy Policy and Terms of Service

message:
Please read and understand the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service carefully before using Ego Wallpaper. To provide wallpaper services, we may collect device technical information (such as device model, OS version, unique pseudonymous identifiers, IP address) and operational logs for performance analysis and optimization.
　　You can review the 《Privacy Policy》 and 《Terms of Service》 for details. If you agree, please tap the button below to start using our services.

messageLocales.zh-Hans:
请你务必审慎阅读、充分理解“隐私政策”和“服务协议”各条款，包括但不限于：为了更好的向你提供服务，我们需要收集你的设备信息，例如设备型号、操作系统版本、唯一设备标识符（如IMEI、Android ID）、IP地址、设备MAC地址、OAID（移动智能终端补充设备标识）等，和操作日志等信息用于分析、优化应用性能。
　　你可阅读《隐私政策》和《服务协议》了解详细信息。如果你同意，请点击下面按钮开始接受我们的服务。
